observations.body: The letter joins calling, election, practiced qualities, stability, and entrance into the eternal Kingdom of Jesus Christ.
observations.label: Entrance richly supplied

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside entrance richly supplied.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read 2 Peter 1:3–15 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the letter joins calling, election, practiced qualities, stability, and entrance into the eternal Kingdom of Jesus Christ. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: Entrance richly supplied
